title: ProBuild Rewards Receipt Claim Allowances
content:
A purchase a Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards member made without the member number can be added to the membership later from the receipt. Two allowances govern this, each fixed per tier: the number of calendar days after the purchase within which the purchase can be added, and the largest number of such purchases added in one program year.

| Tier | Calendar days after the purchase within which it can be added from the receipt | Most purchases added from the receipt in one program year |
|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 90 | 5 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 90 | 5 |
| ProBuild Silver | 90 | 10 |
| ProBuild Gold | 120 | 10 |
| ProBuild Platinum | 120 | 20 |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 180 | 20 |

## Points of reading

- The day allowance is 90 calendar days at the three lowest tiers, 120 at ProBuild Gold and ProBuild Platinum, and 180 at ProBuild Platinum Elite.
- The yearly count is 5 at ProBuild Member and ProBuild Bronze, 10 at ProBuild Silver and ProBuild Gold, and 20 at ProBuild Platinum and ProBuild Platinum Elite; it counts purchases added from the receipt within the program year, the calendar year.
